questions.content: Look at the photograph and select the statement that best describes what you see.
questions.optionA: A woman is typing on a keyboard.
questions.optionB: A woman is setting up a projector.
questions.optionC: A woman is filing documents in a cabinet.
questions.optionD: A woman is drinking water from a bottle.
questions.explanation: Trong tranh người phụ nữ đang ngồi trước máy tính và gõ phím.

questions.content: Where did Mr. Henderson go for the client meeting?
questions.optionA: To the main conference room downtown.
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi bắt đầu bằng 'Where', đáp án trả lời đúng địa điểm là A. Part 2 chỉ có 3 lựa chọn (A, B, C).

questionGroups.passageText:
[Transcript - optional]
Man: Hi Sarah, have you finished the quarterly sales summary yet? The board meeting is at 2 PM.
Woman: Almost done. I am just waiting for the final numbers from the Tokyo branch.
Man: Great. Once you have them, please print five copies for the directors.

questions.content: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
questions.explanation: Người đàn ông hỏi về 'quarterly sales summary'.

questions.optionB: She needs data from another office
questions.explanation: Người phụ nữ nói 'waiting for the final numbers from the Tokyo branch'.

questions.content: What does the man ask the woman to do?
questions.explanation: Người đàn ông nói 'please print five copies'.

questionGroups.passageText:
[Transcript - optional]
Good morning passengers. This is the pre-boarding announcement for flight VN-452 bound for Da Nang. Due to adverse weather conditions at our destination, departure has been pushed back by 45 minutes. Refreshment vouchers are available at Gate 12.

questions.content: Where is the announcement most likely taking place?
questions.explanation: Thông báo dành cho hành khách chuyến bay (flight VN-452, Gate 12).

questions.content: What is the reason for the delay?
questions.explanation: Người nói nhắc đến 'Due to adverse weather conditions'.

questions.content: What can passengers receive at Gate 12?
questions.explanation: Thông báo nhắc: 'Refreshment vouchers are available at Gate 12'.

questions.content: Ms. Johnson requested that the sales team submit _______ weekly reports by Friday afternoon.
questions.explanation: Trước cụm danh từ 'weekly reports' cần tính từ sở hữu 'their'.

questionGroups.passageText:
To: All Employees
From: Facilities Management
Subject: Office Air Conditioning Maintenance

Please be advised that the central ventilation system will be serviced this Saturday, October 15. The maintenance team will begin work at 8:00 AM and expects to finish by 2:00 PM. ----[131]----. During this period, temperatures inside the building may fluctuate significantly. For this reason, we strongly ----[132]---- employees from working in the office over the weekend. All network servers and electrical outlets will remain ----[133]----, so remote access will not be disrupted. We apologize for any ----[134]---- this scheduled maintenance may cause.

questions.content: Select the best phrase for blank [131]
questions.optionA: Power will be shut off entirely.
questions.optionB: This work is routine seasonal maintenance.
questions.optionC: New air filters have already been installed.
questions.optionD: Visitors must register at the reception desk.
questions.explanation: Câu giải thích mục đích bảo trì định kỳ phù hợp với ngữ cảnh.

questions.content: Select the best word for blank [132]
questions.explanation: 'discourage employees from working' khuyên nhân viên không nên đến văn phòng vì nhiệt độ dao động.

questions.content: Select the best word for blank [133]
questions.explanation: Sau động từ liên kết 'remain' cần tính từ 'operational'.

questions.content: Select the best word for blank [134]
questions.explanation: Cụm quen thuộc trong thư thông báo: 'apologize for any inconvenience'.

questionGroups.passageText:
AURORA LOGISTICS - CUSTOMER SERVICE POLICY UPDATE
Effective November 1, Aurora Logistics will implement a new tracking system for all international freight shipments. Customers will now receive automated SMS alerts at three key milestones: cargo departure, customs clearance, and final delivery dispatch.

Additionally, standard insurance coverage will increase from $1,000 to $2,500 per shipment at no extra charge. Inquiries regarding enterprise bulk shipping contracts should be directed to enterprise@auroralogistics.com.

questions.content: What is the announcement mainly about?
questions.optionA: A change in service procedures and coverage
questions.optionC: A merger with another shipping company
questions.optionD: A delay in international delivery schedules
questions.explanation: Thông báo về việc triển khai hệ thống tracking mới và tăng mức bảo hiểm tiêu chuẩn.

questions.content: According to the passage, what is offered without additional fee?
questions.explanation: Đoạn văn nêu rõ: 'standard insurance coverage will increase from $1,000 to $2,500 per shipment at no extra charge'.
